text.body: <1> mahimabhaṭṭaviracitaḥ vyaktivivekaḥ dhvanilakṣaṇākṣepo nāma prathamaḥ vimarśaḥ anumāne'ntarbhāvaṃ sarvasyaiva dhvaneḥ prakāśayitum| vyaktivivekaṃ kurute praṇamya mahimā parāṃ vācam||1|| yukto'yamātmasadṛśān prati me prayatno nāstyeva tajjagati sarvamanoharaṃ yat | kecijjvalanti vikasantyapare nimīlantyanye yadabhyudayabhāji jagatpradīpe||2|| iha sampratipattito'nyathā vā dhvanikārasya vacovivecanaṃ naḥ| niyataṃ yaśase prapatsyate yanmahatāṃ saṃstava eva gauravāya||3|| sahasā yaśo'bhisartuṃ samudyatā'dṛṣṭadarpaṇā mama dhīḥ| svālaṅkāravikalpaprakalpane vetti kathamivāvadyam||4|| dhvanivartmanyatigahane skhalitaṃ vāṇyāḥ pade pade sulabham| rabhasena yat pravṛttā prakāśakaṃ candrikādyadṛṣṭvaiva||5|| kintu tadavadhīryāryairguṇaleśe satatamavahitairbhāvyam| paripavanavadathavā te jātyaiva na śikṣitāstuṣagrahaṇam|| 6 || tatra dhvanereva tāvallakṣaṇaṃ vaktavyam| ko'yaṃ dhvanirnāmeti| tacca dhvanikāreṇaivoktam| tadyathā yatrārthaḥ śabdo vā tamarthamupasarjanīkṛtasvārthau| vyaṅktaḥ kāvyaviśeṣaḥ sa dhvaniriti sūribhiḥ kathitaḥ|| iti| etacca vivicyamānamanumānasyaiva saṅgacchate nānyasya| tathā hyarthasya tāvadupasarjanīkṛtātmatvamanupādeyameva| tasyārthāntarapratītyarthamupāttasya tadvyabhicārābhāvāt| na hyagnyādisiddhau dhūmādirupādīyamāno guṇatāmativartate| tasya tanmātralakṣaṇatvāt| yatpunarasya kvacitsamāsoktyādau prādhānyamucyate tat prākaraṇikatvāpekṣayaiva na pratīyamānāpekṣayā | yathopoḍharāgeṇa vilolatārakaṃ tathā gṛhītaṃ śaśinā niśāmukham| yathā samastaṃ timirāṃśukaṃ tayā puro'pi rāgād galitaṃ na lakṣitam|| || iti| atra hi pratīyamānenānugataṃ vācyameva prādhānyena pratīyate samāropitanāyikānāyakavyavahārayorniśāśaśinoreva vākyārthatvāditi| tadapekṣayā ca tasya liṅgatvādupasarjanībhāvāvyabhicāra eva| vyabhicāre'pi vaiphalyādanupādeyametad guṇībhūtavyaṅgye'pi kāvye cārutvaprakarṣadarśanāditi vakṣyate| uktaṃ guṇīkṛtātmatvaṃ yadarthasya viśeṣaṇam| gamakatvānna tattasya yuktamavyabhicārataḥ||7|| iti saṅgrahaślokaḥ| śabdaḥ punaranupādeya eva | tasya svārthābhidhānamantareṇa vyāpārāntarānupapatterupapādayiṣyamāṇatvāt | na ca tasyānukaraṇavyatirekeṇopasarjanīkṛtārthatvaṃ sambhavati yathā taṃ karṇamūlamāgatya palitacchadmanā jarā | kaikeyīśaṅkayaivāha rāme śrīrnyasyatāmiti || iti | kutastarhi tadarthāvagatiḥ? anukāryāditi brūmas tasya sārthakanirarthakatvabhedena dvaividhyataḥ | na tvanukaraṇāt tasyetinā vyavacchinnasya svarūpamātre'vasthānāt| anyasya tūpasarjanībhāvāvyabhicāra eva tasya tadarthamupādānataḥ| yo hi yadarthamupādīyate nāsau tamevopasarjanīkarotīti yuktaṃ vaktum| yathodakādyupādānārthamupātto ghaṭādisyadevodakādi| anyathā pradhānetaravyavasthā nirnibandhanaiva syāt| ata eva ghaṭādireva pratinidhīyate nodakādītyasambhavo lakṣaṇadoṣaḥ| vyabhicārasambhavayorapi vā yatsvārthayorupasarjanīkṛtatvavacanaṃ tat punaruktaṃ tayorarthāntarābhivyaktyarthamupāttayossāmarthyādeva tadavagaterityuktam| na ca svarūpamātrānuvādaphalametaditi śakyaṃ vaktuṃ tasya punaruktiprakāratvopapādanataḥ| evaṃ ca yat suvarṇapuṣpāṃ pṛthivīṃ cinvanti puruṣāstrayaḥ| śūraśca kṛtavidyaśca yaśca jānāti sevitum|| ityādyudāharaṇamupadarśitaṃ tadasiddhasādhyasādhanadharmānugatamityavagantavyam| kiṃ ca yathā'bhidheyo'rthastadviśeṣaṇaṃ copāttaṃ tadvadabhidhāpyupādānamarhatyeva| anyathā yatra dīpakāderalaṅkārāntarasyopamādeḥ pratītistatra dhvanitvamiṣṭaṃ na syāt tallakṣaṇenāvyāpteḥ| alaṅkārāṇāṃ cābhidhātmatvamupagataṃ teṣāṃ bhaṅgībhaṇitibhedarūpatvāt| alaṅkārāntarasyāpi pratītau yatra bhāsate| tatparatvaṃ na vācyasya nāsau mārgo dhvanermataḥ|| ityādinā tat pratiṣiddhamiti ced ucyate tatpratiṣedhahetoḥ kāvyātatparatālakṣaṇasyāsiddhatvād upamānopameyabhāvādyabhidhānaparatayaiva dīpakādyalaṅkārabhaṅgībhaṇitisamāśrayaṇataḥ pratīyamānasyaiva cālaṅkārādeścārutvātiśayayogāt tāvanmātranibandhanatvācca taddhvanivyavahārasyeti kathaṃ tatpratiṣedhasiddhiḥ? athārthapratītyanyathānupapattyaiva tatsadbhāvāvagamaḥ| arthaśabdayorupasarjanīkṛtasvārthatvābhidhānasāmarthyācca tadupasarjanībhāvāvagatiḥ| tasyāḥ prādhānyena tayorupasarjanībhāva iti vyarthastadupādānaprasaṅga iti| evaṃ tarhyarthasyaivopasarjanībhāvo'bhidheyo na śabdasya tasyābhidhāyā iva tadupasarjanībhāvābhidhānasāmarthyādeva tadavagatisiddheriti lakṣaṇavākye vyarthaṃ śabdagrahaṇam| anyathā'bhidhānagrahaṇamapi kartavyaṃ prasajyeta viśeṣābhāvāt| na cāsya svārthābhidhānamātraparyavasitasāmarthyasya vyāpārāntaramupapadyate yenāyamarthāntaramavagamayet tadapekṣaṃ copasarjanīkṛtārthatvamiyāt| arthasyaiva tadupapattisamarthanāt| sarva eva hi śābdo vyavahāraḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvagarbhatayā prāyeṇānumānarūpo'bhyupagantavyaḥ| tasya parapravṛttinivṛttinibandhanatvāt tayośca sampratyayāsampratyayātmanoranyathākartumaśakyatvataḥ| na hi yuktimanavagacchan kaścidvipaścidvacanamātrāt sampratyayabhāgbhavati| dvividho hi śabdaḥ padavākyabhedāt| tatra padamanekaprakāraṃnāmākhyātopasarganipātakarmapravacanīyabhedāt| tatra sattvapradhānāni nāmāni| tānyapi bahuprakārāṇi sambhavanti| jātiguṇakriyādravyāṇāṃ tatpravṛttinimittānāṃ bahutvāt| tadyathā ghaṭaḥ paṭa iti jātiśabdaḥ| śuklo nīla iti guṇaśabdaḥ| pācakaḥ pāṭhaka iti kriyāśabdaḥ| daṇḍī viṣāṇīti dravyaśabdaḥ| kecit punareṣāṃ kriyaivekā pravṛttinimittamiti kriyāśabdatvameva sarveṣāṃ nāmapadānāmupagacchanti| tathā hi ghaṭādiśabdāḥ svārthe pravartamānā ghaṭanādikriyāmevānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ pravṛttinimittabhāvenāvalambamānā dṛśyante| na ghaṭatvādisāmānyam|sā caiṣā ghaṭanādikriyā ghaṭatvāsāmānyayogādanyathā vā'stu| naitāvatā tasyāḥ pravṛttinimittatvavyāghātaḥ| na ca satyapi ghaṭatvasāmānye svayamaghaṭan ghaṭātmatāmanāpadyamāna evāsau ghaṭavyapadeśaviṣayo bhavitumarhati| evaṃ hi paṭo'pi ghaṭavyapadeśaviṣayaḥ syāt| ghaṭanakriyākartṛtvāviśeṣāt| na hi śuklatvamanāpadyamāna evārthaḥ śukla iti vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyate’pacanneva pācaka iti| tasmād ghaṭanakriyākartṛtvalakṣaṇameva ghaṭatvaṃ ghaṭaśabdasya pravṛttau nimittamavaseyam| na ghaṭatvamātram| tadeva ceha ghaṭanamityuktam| nanu ceṣṭādyarthād ghaṭatyāderdhātorajādau ghaṭata ityādyarthe ghaṭanādikriyaiva sarveṣāṃ ghaṭādiśabdānāṃ pravṛttinimittabhāvenāsmābhirapīṣyata eveti vyarthaḥ pakṣāntaropanyāsaḥ| satyamiṣyata eva bhavadbhiḥ| kintu sā śabdasya vyutpattinimittaṃ na pravṛttinimittam| anyaddhi vyapatpattinimittamanyacca pravṛttinimittam| yathaikeṣāṃ mate gamanādikriyā gavādiśabdānāṃ vyutpattinimittamekārthasamavāyād gotvādi pravṛttinimittīkaroti| ata eva gacchatyagacchati ca gavi gośabdaḥ siddho bhavati| evamihāpi ceṣṭādikriyā ghaṭādiśabdānāṃ vyutpattinimittamiti siddhaṃ bhavati| tadapekṣameva ca vipacya ghaṭo bhavatītyādau vipākādikriyāyāḥ paurvakālyaṃ ktvāpratyayasya viṣayo veditavyaḥ| yathādhiśritya pācako bhavatītyādau pākādyapekṣamadhiśrayaṇāderna bhavanakriyāpekṣam| sā hi nāvaśyaṃ prayujyate| pratīyate tu padārthānāṃ sattā'vyabhicārāt| na tu tāvatā tadapekṣaṃ taditi mantavyaṃ tasyā bahiraṅgatvādarthasyāsaṅgatiprasaṅgācca| prayujyamānakriyāpekṣameva ca prāyeṇa paurvakālyaṃ ktvo viṣayo na pratīyamānāpekṣam| itarathā śrutvā'pi nāma badhiro dṛṣṭvā'pyandho jaḍo viditvā'pi| yo deśakālakāryavyapekṣayā paṇḍitaḥ sa pumān|| ityādi prayogajātamanupapannameva syāt śravaṇādīnāṃ tatpūrvakālatvābhāvāt| atra tu śrutyādiśaktivirahalakṣaṇabādhiryādikriyāpekṣameva śravaṇādīnāṃ paurvakālyamiti na kācidanupapattiḥ| bahvīṣu ca tāsūttarottarakriyāpekṣaṃ pūrvapūrvakriyāpaurvakālyam| yathā snātvā bhuktvā pītvā vrajatītyādau| atra ca vipacanaghaṭanabhavanarūpā bahvyaḥ kriyetyatrāpi ghaṭanāpekṣaṃ vipacanasya tadbhavitumarhatyevobhayatrāpi kartṛpratyayanirdeśāviśeṣāt| kevalaṃ kṛdvācyatayā karturupādhibhāvaṃ gamiteti bhinnakartṛkatvabhramaḥ| yathā śiśirakālamapāsya guṇo'sya naḥ ka iva śītaharasya kucoṣmaṇaḥ| iti dhiyāstaruṣaḥ parirebhire ghanamato namato'numatān priyāḥ ||6.65|| ityatra kucoṣmaṇaḥ karturharaṇakriyā| ata eva kecidapāsyetyayaṃ lyabantapratirūpako nipāta iti vyākhyātavantaḥ| yathā vā nirīkṣya saṃrambhanirastadhairyaṃ rādheyamārādhitajāmadagnyam | asaṃskṛteṣu prasabhaṃ bhayeṣu jāyeta mṛtyorapi pakṣapātaḥ|| ityatra nirīkṣaṇakriyākarturmṛtyorbhayapakṣapatanakriye viṣayaviṣayibhāvabhaṅgyopātte| yathā vā yāṃ dṛṣṭvā'pi samutsuke manasi me nānyā karotyāspadam|| ityatra darśanakriyākarturmanaso'nyakartṛkāspadakriyānadhikaraṇabhāvenopāttasyautsukyakriyā viśeṣaṇabhāvenopāttā kvacit kartuḥ sambandhitāmupagatā'sau| bhramaheturyathā śirasā praṇipatya yācitānyupagūḍhāni savepathūni ca| suratāni ca tāni te rahaḥ smara saṃsmṛtya na śāntirasti me|| iti| kecit punaḥ kartṛkriyayoranupādānamapi hetumicchati| tatra karturyathā nanu sarva eva samavekṣya kamapi guṇameti pūjyatām| sarvaguṇavirahitasya hareḥ paripūjayā kurunarendra! ko guṇaḥ|| iti| atra hi samavekṣāpūjayoreko lokaḥ kartā| sa ca sāmarthyasiddha iti nopāttaḥ| pūjā copāttā'pi kṛdvācyatayā karmopasarjanībhūtetyubhayaṃ bhramahetuḥ| kriyāyā yathā akṛtvā parasantāpamagatvā khalanamratām| anutsṛjya satāṃ mārgaṃ yat svalpamapi tad bahu|| atra hi prakaraṇādigamyāyā lābhakriyāyā anupādānaṃ karaṇādīnāṃ bhinnakartṛkatvabhramahetuḥ| taduktaṃ karturupādhitayoktā kṛdvācyatayā gatānyaguṇatāṃ vā| ktvo bhinnakartṛkatvabhramāya bhavati kriyā'vacaśca tayoḥ|| paurvāparyaṃ kriyāṇāṃ yad vāstavaṃ tadapekṣiṇi| ktvaḥ paurvakālye kiṃ tāsāṃ prādhānyetaracintayā|| ityalamanena| ghaṭatīti ghaṭo jñeyo nāghaṭan ghaṭatāmiyāt| aghaṭatvāviśeṣeṇa paṭo'pi syād ghaṭo'nyathā||8|| ghaṭanañca tadātmatvāpattirūpā kriyā matā| mūlañca tasyāścitrārthabhāsāviṣkṛtirīśituḥ||9|| yaḥ kaścidarthaḥ śabdānāṃ vyutpattau syānnibandhanam| pravṛttau tu kriyaivekā sattā''sādanalakṣaṇā||10|| tasyāmeva kvibādyāśca vidheyāḥ kartṛmātrataḥ| na tūpamānādācāre tayorarthāt pratītitaḥ||11|| yathā hyaśvati bāleya ityato'rthaḥ pratīyate| aśvatvamāsādayati khara ityarthataḥ punaḥ||12|| aśvatulyasamācāraḥ khara ityavasīyate| na tattvasādanaṃ yuktaṃ tadatulyakriyasya hi||13|| sattāyāṃ vyāpṛtiścaiṣā citratvapariniṣṭhiteḥ| saṅgacchate jaḍasyāpi ghaṭāderghaṭanādivat||14|| nāmnaḥ sattvapradhānasya dhātukāro'ta eva hi| śabdavakraikadeśāderdhātvarthatvamavocata||15|| evañca vipacya ghaṭo bhavatīti ktvo'sya pūrvakālatvam| ghaṭanāpekṣaṃ jñeyaṃ bhavanāpekṣantu nāsamanvayataḥ||16|| bahiraṅgatvācca yathā bhavatyadhiśritya pācako'yamiti| atra hi pākāpekṣādhiśrayateḥ pūrvakālatāvagatiḥ||17|| tasmānnāmapadebhyo yaḥ kaścidarthaḥ pratīyate| na sa sattāmanāsādya śabdavācyatvamarhati||18|| itthañcāstibhavatyādi kriyāsāmānyamucyate| nāntaraṅgatayā'vaśyaṃ vaktārastat prayuñjate||19|| kriyāviśeṣo yastvanyaḥ pākādirvyabhicārabhāk| bahiraṅgatayā tasya prayogo'vaśyamiṣyate||20|| iti saṅgrahaślokāḥ| bhāvapradhānamākhyātam | asatvabhūtārthā upasargādayaḥ| teṣāmasatvabhūtārthatvāviśeṣe'pi vyāpāraniyamāt prayoganiyamācca trairāśyopagamaḥ| tathā hi kriyārūpātiśayapratipattinibandhanamupasargāḥ prādayaḥ | bhāvasattvayorātmabhedapratyāyananimittamavadhṛtarūpārthaviśeṣāḥ svarādayo nipātāḥ| kriyāviśeṣopajanitasambandhāvacchedahetavaḥ karmapravacanīyāḥ | taduktaṃ dvidhā kaiścit padaṃ bhinnaṃ caturdhā pañcadhāpi vā| apoddhṛtyaiva vākyebhyaḥ prakṛtipratyayādivat|| iti| etacca vakṣyate| vākyamanekaprakāraṃ kriyāprādhānyāt tasyāścaikatvāt| yadāhuḥ sākāṅkṣāvayavaṃ bhede parānākāṅkṣaśabdakam| kriyāpradhānaṃ guṇavadekārthaṃ vākyamiṣyate|| iti| artho'pi dvividho vācyo'numeyaśca| tatra śabdavyāpāraviṣayo vācyaḥ| sa eva mukhya ucyate| yadāhuḥ śrutimātreṇa yatrāsya sāmarthyamavasīyate| taṃ mukhyamarthaṃ manyante gauṇaṃ yatnopapāditam|| iti| tata eva tadanumitādvā liṅgabhūtādyadarthāntaramanumīyate so'numeyaḥ| sa ca trividho vastumātram alaṅkārā rasādayaśceti| tatrādyau vācyāvapi sambhavataḥ| anyastvanumeya eveti| tatra padasyārtho vācya eva nānumeyas tasya niraṃśatvāt sādhyasādhanabhāvābhāvataḥ| vākyārthastu vācyasyārthasyāṃśaparikalpanāyāmaṃśānāṃ vidhyanuvādabhāvenāvasthitervidheyāṃśasya siddhāsiddhatayopapādanānapekṣasāpekṣatvena dvividho boddhavyaḥ| tatra siddhau vidhyanuvādabhāvaḥ svarūpamātrānuvādāt| yathāstyuttarasyāṃ diśi devatātmā himālayo nāma nagādhirājaḥ| pūrvāparau toyanidhī vagāhya sthitaḥ pṛthivyā iva mānadaṇḍaḥ|| ityatrāsiddho sādhyasādhanabhāvarūpo'nūdyamānasyāṃśasya sādhanaduradhirohāt| sādhyasādhanabhāvaścānayoravinābhāvāvasāyakṛto'vagantavyaḥ| sa ca pramāṇamūlaḥ| tacca trividham| yadāhur loko vedastathādhyātmaṃ pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam| vedādhyātmapadārtheṣu prāyo nāṭyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam|| iti| tatra lokaprasiddhārthaviṣayo lokaḥ| yathā kayāsi kāminsuratāparādhātpādānataḥ kopanayāvadhūtaḥ| yasyāḥ kariṣyāmi dṛḍhānutāpaṃ pravālaśayyāśaraṇaṃ śarīram|| iti| atra hi pādānatitadavadhūtyoḥ sarasāparādhakopanatvayośca lokapramāṇasiddhaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvastanmūlaśca sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ| yathā vā candraṃ gatā padmaguṇānna bhuṅkte padmāśritā cāndramasīmabhikhyām| umāmukhaṃ tu pratipadya lolā dvisaṃśrayāṃ prītimavāpa lakṣmīḥ|| atra hi padmaguṇānāṃ cāndramasyā abhikhyāyāśca yugapadabhoge lakṣmyā yat kāraṇadvayaṃ rātrisaṅkocadivānudayalakṣaṇaṃ tallokaprasiddhameveti nopādeyatāmarhati| śāstramātraprasiddhārthaviṣayo vedaḥ| vedagrahaṇamitihāsapurāṇadharmaśāstrādyupalakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ tanmūlatvopagamāt| yathāyācitāraṃ na hi devadevamadriḥ sutāṃ pratigrāhayituṃ śaśāka| abhyarthanābhaṅgabhayena sādhurmādhyasthyamiṣṭe'pyavalambate’rthe|| iti| atra hi kāraṇabhūtasya bhagavadgatasya sampradānatvanibandhanasya yācanasyābhāve bhūdharendragatasya kāryasya kanyāgrāhaṇaśaktatvasyābhāvopanibandhanaḥ śāstramūlas tayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasya tanmūlatvena prasiddheḥ| yadāhur ayācitāni deyāni sarvadravyāṇi bhārata!| annaṃ vidyā dayā kanyā anarthibhyo na dīyate|| iti| arthī ca sampradānam| yaduktam anirākaraṇāt kartustyāgāṅgaṃ karmaṇepsitam| preraṇānumatibhyāṃ ca labhate saṃpradānatām|| evaṃ ca kāraṇānupalabdhiprayogo’yamārtha iti mantavyam| yathā nātra dhūmo'gnerabhāvāditi| ādhyātmikārthaviṣayamadhyātmam| yathā paśupatirapi tānyahāni kṛcchrādagamayadadrisutāsamāgamotkaḥ| kamaparamavaśaṃ na viprakuryurvibhumapi taṃ yadamī spṛśanti bhāvāḥ|| iti| atra hi bhagavatpaśupatigatasya kṛcchrād divasātivāhanasyādrisutāsamāgamotkatvasya cādhyātmasiddhaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo yanmūlo'yamanayoḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ| sa hi dvividhaḥ śābdaścārthaśceti| so'pi ca sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratyekaṃ padārthavākyārtharūpatvāt padārthasya ca jātiguṇakriyādravyabhedena bhedād dharmadharmitayā ca dharmasyāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyavaiyadhikaraṇyabhedād vākyārthasya ca kriyātmanaḥ kārakavaicitryeṇa vaicitryād yathāyogyamanyonyasāṅkaryād bahuvidha iti tasya diṅmātramidamupadarśyate| tatra dharmamātrasya sādhanabhāve śābdo yathā prajānāṃ vinayādhānādrakṣaṇādbharaṇādapi| sa pitā pitarastāsāṃ kevalaṃ janmahetavaḥ|| tasyaiva dharmasya samānādhikaraṇasyopādāne sattvārtho yathā dviṣatāmudayaḥ sumedhasā gururasvantataraḥ sumarṣaṇaḥ| na mahānapi bhūtimicchatā phalasampatpravaṇaḥ parikṣayaḥ|| iti| atra hi dviṣadudayagatasyāsvantatvasya sumarṣaṇatvasya ca tatparikṣayagatasya phalasampatpravaṇatvasya durmarṣaṇatvasya cārthaḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvo nibaddhaḥ| dharmadharmibhāvābhāve tu padārthamātrasya sādhanatvācchābda eva| yathā durmantrānnṛpatirvinaśyati yatiḥ saṅgāt suto lālanāt vipro'nadhyayanāt kulaṃ kutanayācchīlaṃ khalopāsanāt| hrīrmadyādanavekṣaṇādapi kṛṣiḥ snehaḥ pravāsāśrayānmaitrī cāpraṇayāt samṛddhiranayāt tyāgāt pramādāddhanam|| iti| evaṃ vākyārthaviṣaye'pi sādhyasādhanabhāvo dvividho boddhavyaḥ| tatra śābdo yath sarasyāmetasyāmudarabalivīcīvilulitaṃ yathā lāvaṇyāmbho jaghanapulinollaṅghanaparam| yathā lakṣyaścāyaṃ calanayanamīnavyatikarastathā manye magnaḥ prakaṭakucakumbhaḥ smaragajaḥ|| iti| ārtho yathā nivāryatāmāli! kimapyasau baṭuḥ punarvivakṣuḥ sphuritottarādharaḥ| na kevalaṃ yo mahato'pabhāṣate śṛṇoti tasmādapi yaḥ sa pāpabhāk|| iti| yathā ca divaṃ yadi prārthayase vṛthā śramaḥ pituḥ pradeśāstava devabhūmayaḥ| athopayantāramalaṃ samādhinā na ratnamanviṣyati mṛgyate hi tat|| iti| anumeyārthaviṣayo yathā suvarṇapuṣpāṃ pṛthivīṃ cinvanti puruṣāstrayaḥ| śūraśca kṛtavidyaśca yaśca jānāti sevitum|| iti| atra hi sarvatra sulabhā vibhūtayaḥ śūrādīnāmityayamartho'numīyata ityetad vitaniṣyate| anumitānumeyārthaviṣayo yathā patyuḥ śiraścandrakalāmanena spṛśeti sakhyā parihāsapūrvam| sā rañjayitvā caraṇau kṛtāśīrmālyena tāṃ nirvacanaṃ jaghāna|| ityatra hi nakharañjanānantaraṃ parihāsapūrvaṃ sakhyā kṛtāśiṣo devyā yadetadavacanaṃ mālyena hananaṃ tat tadanubhāvabhūtaṃ tasyāḥ kautukautsukyapraharṣalajjādivyabhicārisampadamanumāpayati| sā cānumīyamānā satī bhagavati bhave bhartari ratimanumāpayati| yathaivaṃvādini devarṣau pārśve pituradhomukhī| līlākamalapatrāṇi gaṇayāmāsa pārvatī|| iti| yathā vā prāyacchatoccaiḥ kusumāni māninī vipakṣagotraṃ dayitena lambitā| na kiñcidūce caraṇena kevalaṃ lilekha bāṣpākulalocanā bhuvam|| iti| yathā ca vākyārthaviṣaye sādhyasādhanabhāve sādhyasādhanapratītyoḥ sulakṣaḥ kramabhāvastathā vastumātrādanumeyaviṣaye'pyavagantavyaḥ| kevalaṃ rasādiṣvanumeyeṣvayamasaṃlakṣyakramo gamyagamakabhāva iti sahabhāvabhrāntimātrakṛtaḥ| tatrānyeṣāṃ vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvābhyupagamas tannibandhanaśca dhvanivyapadeśaḥ| sa tu tatraupacārika eva prayukto na mukhyas tasya vakṣyamāṇanayena bādhitatvāt| upacārasya ca prayojanaṃ sacetanacamatkārakāritvaṃ nāma| taddhi mukhye citrapustakādau vyaktiviṣaye paridṛṣṭameva| vācyo hyartho na tathā camatkāramātanoti yathā sa eva vidhiniṣedhādiḥ kākvabhidheyatāmanumeyatāṃ vā'vatīrṇa iti svabhāva evāyamarthānām| tathā hi mathnāmi kauravaśataṃ samare na kopād duḥśāsanasya rudhiraṃ na pibāmyurastaḥ| saṃcūrṇayāmi gadayā na suyodhanorū sandhiṃ karotu bhavatāṃ nṛpatiḥ paṇena|| ityato lākṣāgṛhānalaviṣānnasabhāpraveśaiḥ prāṇeṣu vittanicayeṣu ca naḥ prahṛtya| ākṛṣṭapāṇḍavavadhūparidhānakeśāḥ svasthā bhavanti mayi jīvati dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ|| ityataśca yathā vidhiniṣedhayoścārutāvagatirna tathā svaśabdavācyasya| dvividhaśca pratiṣedha uktaḥ suptiṅantaviṣayatvāt| tadyathāthāṅgarājādavatārya cakṣuryāteti janyāmavadat kumārī| nāsau na kāmyo na ca veda samyagdraṣṭuṃ na sā bhinnarucirhi lokaḥ|| iti| saṃbhāvyaniṣedhanivartanaṃ hi pratiṣedhadvayasya viṣaya iti| tathā cāha dhvanikāraḥ sārarūpo hyarthaḥ svaśabdānabhidheyatvena prakāśitaḥ sutarāṃ śobhāmāvahati| prasiddhiśceyamastyeva vidagdhapariṣatsu yadabhimatataraṃ vastu vyaṅgyatvena prakāśyate na vācyatveneti| ādyayostu kramasya sulakṣatvād bhrāntirapi nāstīti nirnibandhana eva tatra vyaṅgyavyapadeśagrahaḥ| ata eva śrūyamāṇānāṃ śabdānāṃ dhvanivyapadeśyānāmantaḥsanniveśinaśca sphoṭābhimatasyārthasya vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvo na sambhavatīti vyañjakatvasāmyād yaḥ śabdārthātmani kāvye dhvanivyapadeśaḥ so'pyanupapannas tatrāpi kāryakāraṇamūlasya gamyagamakabhāvasyopagamāt| nanu vibhāvādivākyārthasamakālameva ratyādīnāṃ bhāvānāṃ pratītirupajāyamānā sarvairevāvadhāryate| na tu tatrāntarā sambandhasmaraṇādi vighnavyavadhānasaṃvittiḥ kācidratyādipratītireva rasādipratītiriti mukhyavṛttyaiva vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvābhyupagamaḥ| tatra pradīpaghaṭādivadutpanno gamyagamakabhāvaḥ| yat sa eva āha vyañjakatvamārge tu yadā'rtho'rthāntaraṃ dyotayati tadā svarūpaṃ prakāśayannevāsāvanyasya prakāśakaḥ pratīyate pratīpavat| yathaivaṃvādini devarṣau pārśve pituradhomukhī| līlākamalapatrāṇi gaṇayāmāsa pārvatī|| ityādāviti| punaḥ sa evāha na hi vyaṅgye pratīyamāne vācyabuddhirdūrībhavati vācyāvinābhāvena tasya prakāśanāt| tasmād ghaṭapradīpanyāyastayoḥ| yathaiva hi pradīpadvāreṇa ghaṭapratītāvutpannāyāṃ ma pradīpaprakāśo nivartate tadvyaṅgyapratītau vācyāvabhāsaḥ iti| ucyate vācyapratīyamānayorarthayorthathā krameṇaiva pratītirna samakālam| yathā cānayorgamyagamakabhāvastathā tenaiva vyaktivādinā tayoḥ svarūpaṃ nirūpayitukāmenāpyuktaṃ tadevāsmābhiḥ samādhitsubhiriha likhyate param| tadyathā na hi vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicāriṇa eva rasā iti kasyacidavagamaḥ| ata eva vibhāvādipratītyavinābhāvinī rasādīnāṃ pratītiriti tatpratītyoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvenāvasthānāt kramo'vaśyaṃbhāvī| sa tu lāghavānna prakāśyata ityalakṣyakramā eva santo vyaṅgyā rasādaya ityuktam iti| punaśca tasmādabhidhānābhidheyapratītyoriva vācyavyaṅgyapratītyornimittanimittibhāvānniyamabhāvī kramaḥ| sa tūktayukteḥ kvacillakṣyate kvacittu na lakṣyate iti| tadevaṃ vācyapratīyamānayorvakṣyamāṇakrameṇa liṅgaliṅgibhāvasya samarthanāt sarvasyaiva dhvaneranumānāntarbhāvaḥ samanvito bhavati tasya ca tadapekṣayā mahāviṣayatvāt| mahāviṣayatvaṃ cāsya dhvanivyatirikte'pi viṣaye paryāyoktādau guṇībhūtavyaṅgyādau ca sarvatra sambhavāt| tacca vacanavyāpārapūrvakatvāt parārthamityavagantavyam| trirūpaliṅgākhyānaṃ parārthānumānam iti kevalamuktanayānabhijñatayā tanna lakṣayatyavicakṣaṇo lokaḥ| atha yadi sarva eva vākyārthaḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvagarbha ityucyate tadyathā sādhyasādhanayostatra niyamenopādānaṃ tathā dṛṣṭāntasyāpi syāt tasyāpi vyāptisādhanapramāṇaviṣayatayā'vaśyāpekṣaṇīyatvād na prasiddhasāmarthyasya sādhanasyopādānādeva tadapekṣāyā pratikṣepāt| taduktam tadbhāvahetubhāvau hi dṛṣṭānte tadavedinaḥ| khyāpyete viduṣāṃ vācyo hetureva ca kevalaḥ|| nanu kuto'yaṃ ratyādīnāṃ sukhādyavasthāviśeṣāṇāṃ kāvyādau sacetanacamatkārī sukhāsvādasambhavo yo rasādīnāmanumeyānāṃ vyaṅgyatvopacārasya prayojanāṃśatayā kalpyate| na hi loke liṅgataḥ śokādiṣvanumīyamāneṣvanumātuḥ sukhāsvādalavo'pi lakṣyate| pratyuta sādhūnāmudāsīnānāmapi vā bhayaśokadaurmanasyādiduḥkhamasamamupajāyamānamavadhāryate| na ca lokataḥ kāvyādau kaścidatiśayo yenāsau tatraivopagamyeta na loke| ta eva hi laukikā vibhāvādayo hetukāryasahakārirūpā gamakāḥ| ta eva ca ratyādayo'vasthāviśeṣarūpā bhāvā gamyāḥ| tat ko'tiśayaḥ kāvyādau yat tatraiva rasāsvādo na loke? iti prayojanāṃśāsaṃmbhavād ratyādiṣu vyaṅgyatvopacāro'nupapanna eva| ucyate yatra vibhāvādimukhena bhāvānāmavagamastatraiva sahṛdayaikasaṃvedyo rasāsvādodaya iti vastusvabhāva evāyaṃ na paryanuyogapadavīmavatarati prāmāṇikānām| yadāha bharato vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogādrasaniṣpattiḥ iti| yathoktam bhāvasaṃyojanāvyaṅgyaparasaṃvittigocaraḥ| āsvādanātmānubhavo rasaḥ kāvyārtha ucyate|| iti| na ca loke vibhāvādayo bhāvā vā sambhavanti hetvādīnāmeva tatra sambhavāt| na ca vibhāvādayo hetvādayaścetyeka evārtha iti mantavyam anye hetvādayo'nya eva vibhāvādayas teṣāṃ bhinnalakṣaṇatvāt| tathā hi ye loke ratyādayo rāmādigatāḥ sthemabhājo'vasthāviśeṣāḥ kecit ta eva kāvyādau kaviprabhṛtibhirvarṇanādyarthamātmanyanusaṃhitāḥ santo bhāvayanti tāṃstān rasāniti bhāvā ityucyante| yadāha bharataḥ nānābhinayasambaddhānbhāvayanti rasānimān| yasmāttasmādamī bhāvā vijñeyā nāṭyayoktṛbhiḥ|| iti| ye ca teṣāṃ hetavaḥ sītādyāḥ kecit ta eva kāvyādisamarpitāḥ santo vibhāvyante bhāvā ebhiriti vibhāvā ityucyante|yadāha bharato bahavo'rthā vibhāvyante vāgaṅgābhinayāśrayāḥ| anena yasmāttenāyaṃ vibhāva iti saṃjñitaḥ|| iti| ye ca teṣāṃ kecit kāryarūpā mukhaprasādādayo'rthāsta eva kāvyādyupadarśyamānāḥ santo'nubhāvayanti tāṃstān bhāvānityanubhāvā ityucyante| yadāha bharato vāgaṅgasattvābhinayairyasmādartho'nubhāvyate| vāgaṅgopāṅgasaṃyuktaḥ so'nubhāva iti smṛtaḥ|| iti| ye ca teṣāmantarāntarā'navasthāyino'vasthāviśeṣāstadāvāntarahetujanitā utkalikākārāḥ kecidutpadyante ta eva nijanijavibhāvānubhāvavargamukhenopadarśyamānāḥ santo viśeṣaṇābhimukhyena caranti teṣu teṣu bhāveṣviti vyabhicāriṇa ityucyante| yadāha bharato vividhamābhimukhyena raseṣu carantīti vyabhicāriṇaḥ iti | ye caite sthāyivyabhicārisāttvikabhedādekonapañcāśadbhāvā uktāste sarve vyabhicāriṇa eva| kevalameṣāṃ pratiniyatarūpāpekṣo vyapadeśabhedaḥ| tathā hi sthāyitvaṃ sthāyiṣveva pratiniyataṃ na vyabhicārisāttvikeṣu| vyabhicāritvaṃ vyabhicāriṣveva netarayoḥ| sāttvikatvamapi sāttvikeṣveva netarayoriti| tatra sthāyibhāvānāmubhayī gatiḥ| na vyabhicārisāttvikānām| te hi nityaṃ vyabhicāriṇa eva na jātucit sthāyinaḥ prakalpyante| yattu bhāvādhyāye sthāyināṃ lakṣaṇamuktaṃ tadvyabhicāridaśāpannānāmeva teṣāmavagantavyaṃ nānyeṣāṃ lakṣaṇavacanasya vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| sthāyyanukaraṇātmāno hi rasā iṣyante| te ca pradhānamiti lakṣaṇamukhenaiva teṣāṃ svarūpāvagamasiddhes teṣāṃ bimbapratibimbanyāyenāvasthānāt sthāyibhāveṣu ca nirvedādiṣviva vyabhicāriṇāmanupādānāt| tadupādāne hi teṣāṃ sthāyitvameva syād na vyabhicāritvaṃ nirvedādivat| tasmād yogyatāmātrapravartito'yaṃ vargatrayavibhāgopadarśanāya vyabhicāreṣvapi sthāyivyapadeśaḥ| tanmātravipralambhakṛto'nyeṣāṃ sthāyibhāvalakṣaṇabhrama ityalamaprastutavastuvistareṇa| tadevaṃ vibhāvādīnāṃ hetvādīnāṃ ca kṛtrimākṛtrimatayā kāvyalokaviṣayatayā ca svarūpabhede cāvasthite satyekatvāsiddheryadā vibhāṣādibhirbhāveṣu ratyādiṣvasatyeṣveva pratītirupajanyate tadā teṣāṃ tanmātrasāratvāt pratīyamānā iti gamyā iti ca vyapadeśā mukhyavṛttyopapadyanta eva| tatpratītiparāmarśa eva ca rasāsvādaḥ svābhāvika ityuktam| āstāṃ vā ratyādirnityaparokṣaḥ| pratyakṣo'pi hyarthaḥ sākṣāt saṃvedyamānaḥ sacetasāṃ na tathā camatkāramātanoti yathā sa eva satkavinā vacanagocaratāṃ gamitaḥ| yaduktaṃ kaviśaktyarpitā bhāvāstanmayībhāvayuktitaḥ| yathā sphurantyamī kāvyānna tathā'dhyakṣataḥ kila|| iti| so'pi ca teṣāṃ na tathā svadate yathā tairevānumeyatāṃ nīta iti svabhāva evāyaṃ na paryanuyogamarhati| taduktaṃ nānumito hetvādyaiḥ svadate'numito yathā vibhāvādyaiḥ| na ca sukhayati vācyo'rthaḥ pratīyamānaḥ sa eva yathā|| iti| dhvanikṛtā'pyuktaṃ sārabhūto hyarthaḥ svaśabdānabhidheyatvena prakāśitaḥ sutarāmeva śobhāmāvahati iti| pratītimātraparamārthaṃ ca kāvyādi tāvataiva vineyeṣu vidhiniṣedhavyutpattisiddheḥ| taduktaṃ bhrāntirapi sambandhataḥ pramā iti| maṇipradīpaprabhayormaṇibuddhyābhidhāvatoḥ| mithyājñānāviśeṣe'pi viśeṣo'rthakriyāṃ prati|| iti ca| tenātra gamyagamakabhāvayoḥ sacetasāṃ satyāsatyatvavicāro nirupayoga eva| kāvyaviśeṣe ca vācyavyaṅgyapratītīnāṃ satyāsatyatvavicāro nirupayoga eveti tatra pramāṇāntaraparīkṣopahāsāyaiva sampadyata iti| tatra hetvādibhirakṛtrimairakṛtrimā eva pratyāyyante| tatraiṣāmanumeyatvameva na vyaṅgyalavo'pīti kutastatra sukhāsvādalavo'pi sambhavati| eṣa eva lokataḥ kāvyādāvatiśaya ityupapadyata eva ratyādau gamye sukhāsvādaprayojano vyaṅgyatvopacāra iti| mukhyavṛttyā dvividha evārtho vācyo gamyaśceti| upacāratastu vyaṅgyastṛtīyo'pi samastīti siddham| vāco guṇīkṛtārthatvaṃ na sambhavati jātucit| tadarthaṃ tadupādānādudakārthaṃ dṛteriva|| iti saṅgrahaślokaḥ| nāpi vācyapratīyamānayormukhyavṛttyā vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvaḥ samabhavati vyaktilakṣaṇānupapatteḥ| tathā hi sato'sata eva vā'rthasya prakāśamānasya sambandhasmaraṇānavekṣiṇā prakāśakena sahaiva prakāśaviṣayatāpattirabhivyaktiriti tallakṣaṇamācakṣate| tatra sato'bhivyaktistrividhā tasya traividhyāt| tatra kāraṇātmani kāryasya śaktyātmanā'vasthānāt tirobhūtasyendriyagocaratvāpattilakṣaṇa āvirbhāva ekā yathā kṣīrādyavasthāyāṃ dadhyādeḥ| tathā'vasthānānupagame tu saivotpattirityucyate kaiścit| tasyaivāvirbhūtasya kutaścitpratibandhādaprakāśamānasya prakāśakenopasarjanīkṛtātmanā sahaiva prakāśo dvitīyā yathā pradīpādinā ghaṭādeḥ| taduktaṃ vyāpāradeva tatsiddhe kāraṇānāṃ ca kāryatā| svajñānenānyadhīhetuḥ siddhe'rthe vyañjako mataḥ|| iti| yathā dīpo'nyathā vāpi ko viśeṣo'sya kārakāt| karaṇānāṃ samagrāṇāṃ vyāpārādupalabdhitaḥ|| iti| dhvanikāreṇāpyuktaṃ svarūpaṃ prakāśayanneva parāvabhāsako vyañjaka ityucyate | yathā pradīpo ghaṭāderiti| tasyaivānubhūtapūrvasya saṃskārātmanā'ntarviparivartinaḥ kutaścidavyabhicāriṇo'rthāntarāt tatpratipādakādvā saṃskāraprabodhamātraṃ tṛtīyā yathā dhūmādagneḥ| yathā cālekhyapustakapratibimbānukaraṇādibhyaḥ śabdācca gavādeḥ| asatastvekaprakāraiva tasya prakārāntarāsambhavād yathā'rkalokādinendracāpāderiti| na caitallakṣaṇaṃ vācye saṅgacchate| tathā hi dhvanilakṣmaṇīti daśa doṣāḥ| ye tvanye tadbhedaprabhedalakṣaṇagatā na te gaṇitāḥ||24|| tadevaṃ lakṣaṇadoṣaduṣṭapadavyudāsena pariśuddho dhvanilakṣaṇavākyasyāyamartho'vatiṣṭhate vācyastadanumito vā yatrārtho'rthāntaraṃ prakāśayati| sambandhataḥ kutaścit sā kāvyānumitirityuktā||25|| etaccānumānasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ nānyasya| yaduktaṃ trirūpaliṅgākhyānaṃ parārthānumānam iti| kevalaṃ saṃjñābhedaḥ| kāvyasyātmani saṃjñini rasādirūpe na kasyacid vimatiḥ| saṃjñāyāṃ sā yataḥ kevalameṣā'pi vyaktyayogato'sya kutaḥ||26|| śabdasyaikābhidhā śaktirarthasyaikaiva liṅgatā| na vyañjakatvamanayoḥ samastītyupapāditam||27|| uktaṃ vṛthaiva śabdasyopādānaṃ lakṣaṇe dhvaneḥ| na hi tacchiṣṭamūleṣṭā kācidarthāntare gatiḥ||28|| na copasarjanatvena tayoryuktaṃ viśeṣaṇam| yataḥ kāvye guṇībhūtavyaṅgye'pīṣṭaiva cārutā||29|| ata eva viśeṣasyopādānamapi nārthavat| saṃjñāsambandhamātraikaphalaṃ taditi gamyate||30|| tadā cātiprasaṅgaḥ syāt saṃjñāyāṃ yasya kasyacit| yadvākyavartino'nyasya viśeṣasya tadāptitaḥ||31|| tasmāt sphuṭatayā yatra prādhānyenānyathā'pi vā| vācyaśaktyā'numeyo'rtho bhāti tat kāvyamucyate||32|| vācyapratyeyayornāsti vyaṅgyavyañjakatā'rthayoḥ| tayoḥ pradīpaghaṭavat sāhityenāprakāśanāt||33|| pakṣadharmatvasambandhavyāptisiddhivyapekṣaṇāt| vṛkṣatvāmratvayoryadvad yadvaccānaladhūmayoḥ||34|| anumānatvamevātra yuktaṃ tallakṣaṇānvayāt| asataścendracāpādeḥ kā vyaktiḥ kṛtireva sā||35|| kāryatvaṃ hyasato'pīṣṭaṃ hetutvaṃ tu viruddhyate| sarvasāmarthyavigamād gaganendīvarādivat||36|| śabdaprayogaḥ prāyeṇa parārthamupayujyate| na hi tena vinā śakyo vyavahārayituṃ paraḥ||37|| na ca yuktinirāśaṃsāt tataḥ kaścit pravartate| nivartate vetyasyeṣṭā sādhyasādhanagarbhatā||38|| te pratyekaṃ dvidhā jñeye śābdatvārthatvabhedataḥ| padārthavākyārthatayā te api dvividhe mate||39|| tatra sādhyo vastumātramalaṅkārā rasādayaḥ| iti tridhaiva tatrādyau padaṃ śabdānumānayoḥ||40|| antyo'numeyo bhaktyā tu tasya vyaṅgyatvamucyate| bhakteḥ prayojanāṃśo yaścamatkāritvalakṣaṇaḥ||41|| sa tatrāstīti so'pyasya vibhāvādyekahetukaḥ| ata eva na loke'pi camatkāraḥ prasajyate||42|| tatra hetvādayaḥ santi ma vibhāvādayo yataḥ| na tvaikārthatvamāśaṅkyameṣāṃ lakṣaṇabhedataḥ||43|| svabhāvaścāyamarthānāṃ yanna sākṣādamī tathā| svadante satkavigirāṃ gatā gocaratāṃ yathā||44|| iti saṅgrahaślokāḥ| yat punarasyānekaśaktisamāśrayatvād vyāpārantaraparikalpanaṃ tadarthasyaivopapadyate na śabdasya tasyānekaśaktisamāśrayatvāsiddheḥ| tathā hyekāśrayāḥ śaktayo'nyonyānapekṣapravṛttayo'prākṛtapaurvāparyaniyamā yugapadeva svakāryakāriṇyo dṛṣṭā yathā dāhakatvaprakāśakatvādayo'gneḥ| na ca śabdāśrayāḥ śaktayastathā dṛśyante'bhyupagamyante vā niyogatobhidhāśaktipūrvakatvenetaraśaktipravṛttidarśanāt| tasmād bhinnāśrayā eva tā na śabdaikasamāśrayā ityavaseyam| yaścāsāvāśrayo bhinnaḥ so'rtha eveti tadvyāparasyānumānāntarbhāvo'bhyupagantavya eva| tathā hi gaurvāhīka ityādau tāvad gavādayo'rthā bādhitavāhīkādyarthāntaraikātmyāstādrūpyavidhānānyathā'nupapattyā kenacidaṃśena tatra tattvamanumāpayanti na sarvātmanā| na hyanunmattaḥ kaścit kvacit kiñcit kathañcit sādharmyamanutpaśyannevākasmāt tattvamāropayatīti pariśīlitavaktṛsvarūpaḥ pratipattā tattvāropanimittaṃ sādṛśyamātrameva pratipattumarhati na tattvam| taddhi vācyatayopakrama eva bhāsate na pratītiparyavasānāspadaṃ bhavitumarhati tasya bādhopapatteḥ| tasya caivaṃvidhasyopakramasya nimittaṃ sādharmyamātrapratipādanam| prayojanaṃ ca lāghavena vāhīkādau gavādigatajāḍyādidharmapratipādanaṃ yasmādatideśaprakāro'yamarthāntare śabdaniveśo nāma| yaduktaṃ jātiśabdo'ntareṇāpi jātiṃ yatra prayujyate| sambandhisadṛśād dharmāt taṃ gauṇamapare viduḥ|| iti| evam parimlānaṃ pīnastanajaghanasaṅgādubhayatastanormadhyasyāntaḥ parimilanamaprāpya haritam| idaṃ vyastanyāsaṃ ślathabhujalatākṣepavalanaiḥ kṛśāṅgyāḥ santāpaṃ vadati bisinīpatraśayanam|| ityādāvavagantavyam| avinābhāvāvasāyapūrvikā hyanyato'nyasya pratītiranumānamityanumānalakṣaṇamuktaṃ taccātropalabhyata eva| tathā hi vadatītyādau vadanāderarthāntarasya prakāśādeḥ pratītiḥ| tayoścāvinābhāvaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvakṛtaḥ prakāśanasya vadanakāryatvaprasiddheḥ| na ca vadateḥ prakāśo vācya iti śakyaṃ vaktuṃ tasya tatrāsamitatvāt prakāśasya cātattvāt| na cāyaṃ svārthameva pratipādayati tasya bādhopapatteḥ| athopacārata upādānānyathā'nupapattyā vadanakriyāyāḥ sadṛśe prakāśanākhye kriyāntare vartate'yaṃ vadatirityucyate tarhyanyathā'nupapattyā vadanādeḥ prakāśādiḥ pratīyamāno'numeya eva bhavitumarhaty arthāpatteranumānāntarbhāvābhyupagamādityuktam| tasmādyo'yaṃ vāhīkādau gavādisādharmyāvagamaḥ sa tattvāropānyathā'nupapattiparikalpito'numānasyaiva viṣayo na śabdavyāpārasyeti sthitam| gotvāropeṇa vāhīke tatsāmyamanumīyate| ko hyatasminnatattulye tattvaṃ vyapadiśed budhaḥ||45|| iti saṅgrahaślokaḥ| gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādāvapi gaṅgādayo'rthāḥ svātmanyanupapattibādhitaghoṣādyadhikaraṇabhāvāstadupādānasāmarthyāt sambandhamātraparikalpitatattvāropaṃ tadadhikaraṇabhāvopagamayogyamarthāntarameva taṭādirūpamanumāpayanti| na hi tatsādṛśyamevaikaṃ tattvāropanibandhanamiṣyate| kiṃ tarhi tatsambandhādirapīti tatsambandhamātrasamāropitatadbhāvastaṭādireva ghoṣādyadhikaraṇabhāvopādānānyathā'nupapattyā gaṅgādīnāmarthānāmanumeya eva bhavitumarhati| śabdaḥ punaḥ svārthābhidhānamātravyāpāraparyavasitasāmarthyo nārthāntarasya taṭādervārtāmapi veditumutsahate kiṃ punaḥ saṃsparśam ityuktam| prayojanaṃ punarasyaivaṃvidhasyoktivaicitryaparigrahasya taṭādāvāropaviṣaye vastuni āropyamāṇagaṅgādigatapuṇyatvaśītalatvādidharmapratipattir na sādṛśyamiti pūrvasmādasya viśeṣaḥ| ubhayatrāpi ca tattvāropa eva hetuḥ| sa hi tatsāmyatatsambandhādinibandhanatvād bahuvidha iṣṭaḥ| yadāhur abhidheyena sāmīpyātsārūpyātsamavāyataḥ | vaiparītyātkriyāyogāllakṣaṇā pañcadhā matā || tasya ca tairavinābhāvaniyamo lokata evāvasita iti na tatra pramāṇāntarāpekṣāprayāsaḥ| loko hi tatsadṛśamarthaṃ tatsambaddhaṃ ca tattvena vyavaharan dṛśyate| tad yathā dīrghagrīvaṃ vikaṭakāyaṃ ca kañcit paśyan karabha iti vyapadiśati mañcasambaddhāṃśca kāṃścit krośato mañcāḥ krośantīti| kiṃ copacāravṛttau śabdasya mā bhūdatiprasaṅga ityavaśyaṃ kimapi nimittamanusartavyam| anyathā'nyatra prasiddhasambandhaḥ kathamasamitamevārthāntaraṃ pratyāyayet| yacca tannimittaṃ tadevāsmābhiriha liṅgamityākhyātam| yuktaṃ caitat śabdasya tatra vyāpārābhāvād vyāpārābhāvaśca sambandhābhāvāt| liṅgācca liṅginaḥ pratītiranumānameveti na guṇavṛttāvarthāntarapratītiḥ śābdīti tasyā vācakāśratvamasiddhameva| yaḥ satattvasamāropastatsambandhanibandhanaḥ| mukhyārthabādhe so'pyārthaṃ sambandhamanumāpayet||46|| tatsāmyatatsambandhau hi tattvāropaikakāraṇam| guṇavṛtterdvirūpāyāstatpratītirato'numā||47|| mukhyavṛttiparityāgo na śabdasyopapadyate| vihito'rthāntare hyarthaḥ svasāmyamanumāpayet||48|| tulyādiṣu hi loko'rtheṣvarthaṃ taddarśanasmṛtam| āropayenna śabdastu svārthamātrānuyāyinām||49|| itthamarthāntare śabdavṛtteranupapattitaḥ| phale liṅgaikagamye syāt kutaḥ śabdaḥ skhaladgatiḥ||50|| vyāpārārthe dhvaneḥ sākṣānmukhyā vṛttirudāhṛtā| arthāropānugastveṣa gauṇī tadvyavadhānataḥ||51|| āśubhāvādanālakṣyaṃ kintvarthāropamantarā| loko goścaitra ityādau śabdāropamavasyati||52|| pradhānetarabhāvenāvasthānādarthaśabdayoḥ| samaśīrṣikayā''ropo na tayorupapadyate||53|| āropaviṣaye yatra viśeṣaḥ sampratīyate| arthāropitāt tatra guṇavṛttirudāhṛtā||54|| guṇavṛttau girāṃ yāvat sāmagrīṣṭā nibandhanam| saiva liṅgatayā'smābhiriṣyate'rthāntaraṃ prati||55|| na hi tat samayābhāvād vācyaṃ śabdasya kalpyate| pratīyamānatāyāṃ ca vyaktamasyānumeyatā||56|| tasmāt svārthātirekeṇa gatirnārthāntare girām| vācakatvāśrayeṇāto guṇavṛtterasambhavaḥ||57|| bhaktyā bibharti caikatvaṃ rūpabhedādayaṃ dhvaniḥ| na ca nāvyāptyativyāptyorabhāvāllakṣyate tayā||58|| suvarṇapuṣpāmityādau na cāvyāptiḥ prasajyate| yataḥ padārthavākyārthabhedāt bhaktirdvidhoditā||59|| atasmiṃstatsamāropo bhakterlakṣaṇamiṣyate| arthāntarapratītyarthaḥ prakāraḥ so'pi śasyate||60|| tataśca rūḍhā ye viṣaye'nyatra śabdāḥ svaviṣayādapi| lāvaṇyādyāḥ prasaktāste na bhavanti padaṃ dhvaneḥ||61|| bhavantyevetyarthaḥ| yataḥ mukhyāṃ vṛttiṃ parityajya guṇavṛttyā'rthadarśanam| yaduddiśya phalaṃ tatra śabdo naiva skhaladgatiḥ||62|| vācakatvāśrayeṇaiva guṇavṛttirasaṅgatā| gamakatvaikamūlasya dhvaneḥ syād viṣayo na kim||63|| vyañjakatvaikamūlatvamasiddhañca dhvaneryataḥ| gamakatvāśrayā'pīṣṭā guṇavṛttistadāśrayaḥ||64|| samididhmādayaḥ śabdāḥ prasiddhā guṇavṛttayaḥ| dhvaneḥ padādivyaṅgyasya yenodāharaṇīkṛtāḥ||65|| tasmād vyutpattiśaktibhyāṃ nibandho yaḥ skhaladgateḥ| śabdasya so'pi vijñeyo'numānaviṣayo'nyavat||66|| iti saṅgrahaślokāḥ| viṣaṃ bhakṣaya mā cāsya gṛhe bhuṅkthā ityādāvapi yadetad viṣabhakṣaṇānujñānaṃ tadarthaprakaraṇādisahāyametadgṛhe bhojanasya tato'pi dāruṇatarapariṇāmatvamanumāpayati| na hyanunmattaḥ suhṛdādau hitakāmaḥ sannasya kvacid bhojananiṣedhaṃ vidadhāno'kasmād viṣabhakṣaṇamanujānātītyavagatavaktṛprakaraṇādisvarūpaḥ pratipattā viṣabhakṣaṇānujñānādeva tadgṛhabhojanasyātyantamakaraṇīyatvamanumātumarhati| viṣabhakṣaṇānujñānādervākyārthasyāprastutasyaivopanyāso hi pūrvoktena nayena prastutātiriktārthāntarapratipādanaparatvāt tatra hetutayā'vagantavya iti na śabdasya tatra vyāpāraḥ parikalpanīyaḥ| viṣabhakṣaṇādapi parāmetadgṛhabhojanasya dāruṇatām| vācyādato'numimate prakaraṇavaktṛsvarūpajñāḥ||67|| viṣabhakṣaṇamanumanute na hi kaścidakāṇḍa eva suhṛdi sudhīḥ| tenātrārthāntaragatirārthī tātparyaśaktijā na punaḥ||68|| iti saṅgrahārthe| yadapyanye na manyante vācyāvagamopakramaḥ pratīyamānārthāntarāvasāyaparyanto'yameka eva dīrghadīrghaḥ śabdasyoṣoriva vyāpāro na punararthāntarasya kaścit saṃvedyate| yathā hyeka eveṣurbalavatā dhanuṣmatā muktaḥ śatroruraśchadamuraśca bhittvā jīvitamapaharati| na ca tasya vṛttibhedas tathā śabdo'pi satkavinā sakṛt prayukta eva krameṇa svārthābhidhānamarthāntarapratītiṃ caikayaiva pravṛttyā vitanoti| na ca tasya vyāpārabhedaḥ kaścit kiṃ ca yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa śabdārthaḥ iti vācyavācakabhāvākhyastamanurundhāna eva gamakatvalakṣaṇo vyāpāraḥ sāmagryantarasadbhāvādaupādhikaḥ pravartate| ata eva ca vācakatvāt tasya viśeṣaḥ| vācakatvaṃ hi śabdaviśeṣasya niyata ātmā saṅketavyutpattikālādārabhya tadavinābhāvena tasya prasiddhatvāt| sa tvaniyata aupādhikatvāt prakaraṇādyavacchedena tasyetarathātvapratīteriti| na cānayoranyaḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavatīti tasyāḥ sāmagryā eva sambandhabalāt tadgamakatvamupapannaṃ na śabdasyeti nārthapakṣādasya kaścid viśeṣa iti vyarthastatpakṣopanyāsaḥ| nanu yadi śabdasyārthanirapekṣasya vyañjakatvaṃ neṣyate tat kathaṃ prāptamityādau prādīnāṃ dyotakatvamuktaṃ na vācakatvam| vācakatve hi halāditvāt dhātoryaṅādiprasaṅgaḥ syāt| dyotakatvaṃ prakāśakatvaṃ vyañjakatvaṃ cetyeka evārtha iti? satyam uktamupacārato na paramārthata iti tasya pradīpādiniṣṭhasya vāstavasya śabdārthaviṣayatvasya pratikṣepāt| athocyate pacatyādayaḥ kriyāsāmānyavacanāḥ| sāmānyāni cāśeṣaviśeṣāntarbhāvabhāñji bhavantīti tatpratītināntarīyakatayaiva viśeṣasadbhāvaḥ siddha eva| yadāhur nirviśeṣaṃ hi sāmānyaṃ bhavecchaśaviṣāṇavat|| iti kevalamarthasāmarthyaseddho'pi dyotanamapekṣata iti tanmātravyāpārāḥ prādayo dyotakā eva bhavitumarhanti na vācakā iti| satyaṃ kiṃ tu yadapratītau sāmānyapratītireva na paryavasati tadviśeṣamātraṃ tebhyaḥ pratīyatāṃ nāma| na tu tāvatā vyavahārasiddhiḥ kācit| tasyāḥ pratiniyataviśeṣāvasāyanibandhanatvāt| sa tvapūrvatayā prādibhya evodbhavannavadhāryate na pacatyādibhyo nārthādapi tatsadbhāvasiddhiḥ kācid asyāḥ pratiniyataviśeṣāvasāyanibandhanatvāt| tasmād yatprayogānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyinī yasya pratītistayorvācyavācakabhāvavyavahāraviṣayatvamevopagantuṃ yuktaṃ nābhivyaktiviṣayatvam| yathā ghaṭaśabdatadarthayoḥ| prādiprayogānuvidhāyinī tatra pacatītyādau prakarṣādipratītiriti te'pi tathā bhavitumarhantyeva| anyathā nīlotpalādau sarvasyaiva viśeṣaṇābhimatasya nīlādiśabdasya viśeṣavācinaścotpalāderviśeṣaṇaviśeṣabhāvavyavahāro'stamupagacchet| tatrāpi hyetacchakyaṃ vaktum| utpalādayaḥ śabdāḥ sāmānyavacanāḥ| sāmānyāni ca garbhīkṛtaviśeṣāṇi bhavantīti teṣāṃ tatra sadbhāvasiddhau satyāṃ nīlādiśabdā api tattadyotanamātravyāpārāḥ prādivad dyotakā bhavitumarhanti nābhidhāyakā iti| evaṃ cāntarmātraviparivartitayā siddhasadbhāvānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ ghaṭādiśabdā api dyotakā eva syur na vācakā iti vācyavācakavyavahāro'stamiyāt| tasmād bhāktameva dyotakatvamupagantavyaṃ na mukhyam| bhakteśca prayojanaṃ vācyasyārthasya sphuṭatvapratipattiḥ| nimittaṃ ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣapratītyorāśubhāvitayā kramānupalakṣaṇāt sahabhāvapratītiḥ| dvividhaṃ hi viśeṣaṇamiṣṭam antaraṅgaṃ bahiraṅgaṃ ceti| tatrādyam avyavahitamevārthakāri lākṣādivat sphaṭikādeḥ| dvitīyam ubhayarūpam ayaskāntamiva lohasya| taddhi vyavahitamapi lohe svāṃ śaktimupadadhātyeva| tadapi dvividhaṃ samānādhikaraṇaṃ bhinnādhikaraṇaṃ ceti| viśeṣyo'pi dvividho dhātvartho nāmārthaśceti| tatropasargāṇāṃ prāyo dhātvartho viṣayo na nāmārthaḥ| cādīnāṃ tu nipātānāmubhayamapi| kevalaṃ teṣāṃ viśeṣyāt pūrvaṃ paścācca krameṇa prayogo niyogato'vagantavyo nānyeṣāṃ viśeṣaṇānām| tadevaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasvarūpe'vasite yadetadantaraṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇamuktaṃ tad gavādau gotvādivad viśeṣyasvarūpāntarbhūtamiveti tatpratītyorāśubhāvitayā kramānupalakṣaṇāt sahabhāvāvagamo dyotyadyotakabhāvabhramahetuḥ| ata eva kecideṣāṃ dhātvantarbhāvamiva manyamānā aḍādīnāṃ vyavasthārthaṃ pṛthaktvena prakalpanam| dhātūpasargayoḥ śāstre dhātureva tu tādṛśaḥ|| ityādyavocan| cādīnāṃ copādhīnāṃ viśeṣyebhyo nirmalebhyaḥ sphaṭikopalebhya iva lākṣādīnāmavyavadhānameva| tena te yadanantaramupādhīyate teṣveva viśeṣamādhātumalaṃ nānyatreti| yatteṣāṃ bhinnakramatayā kvacidupādānaṃ tadanupapannmeva| ayathāsthānaviniveśino hi te'rthāntaramanabhimatameva svoparāgeṇoparañjayeyuḥ| tataśca prastutārthasyāsāmāñjasyaprasaṅgaḥ| kathañcid vā bhinnakramatayā'pyabhimatārthasambandhopakalpane prastutārthapratītervighnitatvāt tannibandhane rasāsvādo'pi vighnitaḥ syāt śabdadoṣāṇāmanaucityopagamāt tasya ca rasabhaṅgahetutvāt| yathā''hur anaucityādṛte nānyadrasabhaṅgasya kāraṇam| prasiddhaucityabandhastu rasasyopaniṣatparā|| iti| svābhāvikaṃ dhvaneryuktaṃ vyañjakatvaṃ na dīpavat| dhūmavat kintu kṛtakaṃ sambandhāderapekṣaṇāt||74|| prādīnāṃ dyotakatvaṃ yat kaiścidabhyupagamyate| tad bhāktameva tatreṣṭaṃ na mukhyaṃ tadasambhavāt||75|| tathā hi yasya śabdasya bhāvābhāvānusāriṇī| yadarthabuddhistasyāsau vācyo'rtha iti kathyate||76|| gośabdasyeva gaurarthaḥ sā'nyathā tvavyavasthitā| vācyatvavyavahāraśca na syādarthasya kasyacit||77|| prādiprayogānugamavyatirekānusāriṇī| prakarṣādau matistena tasya tadvācyatā na kim||78|| viśeṣāvagamasyāśubhāvādanupalakṣaṇāt| kramasya sahabhāvitvaṃ bhramo bhakternibandhanam||79|| viśeṣaṇaṃ tu dvividhamāntaraṃ bāhyameva ca| tatrāvyavahitaṃ sad yadarthakāri tadāntaram||80|| sphaṭikasyeva lākṣādi dvitīyamubhayātmakam| āyasasyeva tatkāntaṃ tadapi dvividhaṃ matam||81|| asamānasamānādhikaraṇatvavibhedataḥ| viśeṣyo'pi dvidhā jñeyo dhātunāmārthabhedataḥ||82|| śābdatvārthatvabhedena nāmārtho'pi dvidhā mataḥ| tatropasargāṇāṃ prāyo dhātvartho viṣayo mataḥ||83|| cādīnāṃ tu nipātānāmubhayaṃ parikīrtitam| kevalaṃ tu viśeṣyāt syuḥ pūrvaṃ paścācca te kramāt||84|| viśeṣaṇānāmanyeṣāṃ paurvāparyamayantritam| itthaṃ sthite svarūpe'smin viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ||85|| yadantaraṅgamuddiṣṭamubhayātmā viśeṣaṇam| viśeṣye magnamiva tad gavi gotvamiva sthitam||86|| ata evāśubhāvitvāt tatpratītyoḥ kramāgrahaḥ| yanmūlaścāyamanayordyotyadyotakatābhramaḥ||87|| prādīnāṃ dhātugarbhatvopagamācca yaduktavān| aḍādīnāṃ vyavasthārthamityādi viduṣāṃ varaḥ||88|| ata eva vyavahitairbudhā necchanti cādibhiḥ| sambandhaṃ te hi śaktiṃ svāmupadadhyuranantare||89|| sāntaratve tu tāṃ śaktimanyatraivādadhatyamī| tataścārthāsāmañjasyādanaucityaṃ prasajyate||90|| bahiraṅgāntaraṅgatvabhedāt tad dvividhaṃ matam| tatra śabdaikaviṣayaṃ bahiraṅgaṃ pracakṣate||91|| dvitīyamarthaviṣayaṃ tat tvādyaireva pradarśitam| tatsvarūpamatho'smābhiriha nāti pratanyate||92|| pāramparyeṇa sākṣācca tadetat pratipadyate| kaverajāgarūkasya rasabhaṅganimittatām||93|| yat tvetacchabdaviṣayaṃ bahudhā paridṛśyate| tasya prakramabhedādyā doṣāḥ pañcaiva yonayaḥ||94|| teṣāṃ saṃkṣepato'smābhiḥ svarūpamabhidhāsyate| yastu prapañcaḥ pañcānāṃ svayaṃ tamavadhārayet||95|| iti saṅgrahaślokāḥ| kiṃ ca kāvyasya svarūpaṃ vyutpādayitukāmena matimatā tallakṣaṇameva sāmānyenākhyātavyaṃ yatra vācyapratīyamānayorgamyagamakabhāvasaṃsparśastat kāvyam iti tāvataiva vyutpattisiddheḥ| yat tu tadanākhyāyaiva tayoḥ pradhānetarabhāvakalpanena prakāradvayamuktaṃ tadaprayojakameva| yo hi yadviśeṣapratītau nimittabhāvena niścitaḥ sa eva tadarthinaḥ pratipādyo bhavati nānyo’tiprasaṅgāt| yathā daṇḍipratītau daṇḍaḥ| anumeyārthasaṃsparśamātraṃ cānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kāvyasya cārutvaheturniścitam| atastadeva vaktavyaṃ bhavati na tvasya prādhānyāprādhānyakṛto viśeṣaḥ| na hi tayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayostriṣvapi vastumātrādiṣvanumeyeṣu cetanacamatkārī kaścidviśeṣo'vagamyate| tatra vastumātrasya prādhānye yathāvacca maha vvia ekkāe hontu ṇīsāsaroīavvāim| mā tujjha vi tīe viṇa dakkhiṇṇahaassa jāandu|| iti| vraja mamaivekasyā bhavantu niśvāsaroditavyāni| mā tavāpi tayā vinā dākṣiṇyahatasya janiṣata|| iti| tasyaivāprādhānye yathālāvaṇyasindhuraparaiva hi keyamatra yatrotpalāni śaśinā saha samplavante | unmajjati dviradakumbhataṭī ca yatra yatrāpare kadalikāṇḍamṛṇāladaṇḍāḥ || iti| yathā ca anurāgavatī sandhyā divasastatpurassaraḥ | aho daivagatiścitrā tathāpi na samāgamaḥ || iti| alaṅkārasya prādhānye yathā vīrāṇa ramai ghusṛṇāruṇammi ṇa tahā piāthaṇucchaṅge| diṭhṭhī riugaakumbhatthalammi jaha bahalasiṇḍūre|| iti| vīrāṇāṃ ramate dṛṣṭiḥ ghusṛṇāruṇe na tathā priyāstanotsaṅge| dṛṣṭī ripujanakumbhasthale yathā bahalasindūre|| iti| yathā ca taṃ tāṇa sirisasahoararaaṇāharaṇammi hiaamekkarasam| bimbāhare piāṇaṃ ṇipesiaṃ kusumabāṇena|| iti| tatteṣāṃ śrīsahodararatnāharaṇe hṛdayamekarasam| bimbādhare priyāṇāṃ niveśitaṃ kusumabāṇena|| iti| viṣamabāṇalīlā|| tasyaivāprādhānye yathā candamauehi ṇisā ṇaliṇī kamalehi kusumagucchehi laā| haṃsehi saraasohā kavvakahā sajjaṇehi karai guruī|| iti| candramayūkhairniśā nalinī kamalaiḥ kusumagucchairlatā| haṃsaiḥ śāradaśobhā kāvyakathā sajjanaiḥ kriyate gurvī|| iti| rasādīnāṃ prādhānye yathā kumārasambhave madhuprasaṅge vasantapuṣpābharaṇaṃ vahantyā devyā āgamanādivarṇane manobhavaśarasandhānaparyante śambhośca vivṛtadhairyasya ceṣṭāviśeṣavarṇanādau| teṣāmaprādhānyaṃ śuddhasaṅkīrṇatādibhedād dvividham|tatra śuddhaṃ yathā kiṃ hāsyena na me prayāsyasi punaḥ prāptaścirādṛrśanaṃ keyaṃ niṣkaruṇa pravāsarucitā kenāsi dūrīkṛtaḥ| svapnānteṣviti te vadanpriyatamavyāsaktakaṇṭhagraho buddhvā roditi riktabāhuvalayastāraṃ ripustrījanaḥ|| iti| ityatra karuṇasya śuddhasyaivāṅgabhāvaḥ| saṅkīrṇarasādāvaṅgabhūte yathā kṣipto hastāvalagnaḥ prasabhamabhihato'pyādadāno'śukāntaṃ gṛhṇankeśeṣvapāstaścaraṇanipatito nekṣitaḥ sambhrameṇa| āliṅganyo'vadhūtastripurayuvatibhiḥ sāśrunetrotpalābhiḥ kāmīvārdrāparādhaḥ sa dahatu duritaṃ śāmbhavo vaḥ śarāgniḥ|| iti| atra hi tripuraripuprabhāvātiśayasya vākyārthatva īrṣyāvipralambhasya śleṣasahitasyaivāṅgabhāvaḥ| tadevaṃ prakāratraye'pyanumeyārthassparśa eva kāvyasya cārutvaheturityavagantavyam| yadāha dhvanikāraḥ sarvathā nāstyeva sahṛdayahṛdayahāriṇaḥ kāvyasya sa prakāro yatra na pratīyamānārthasaṃsparśena saubhāgyam| tadidaṃ kāvyarahasyaṃ paramiti sūribhirbhāvanīyam iti| mukhyā mahākavigirāmalaṅkṛtibhṛtāmapi| pratīyamānacchāyaiṣā bhūṣā lajjeva yoṣitām|| iti| punaḥ sa eva yathāprakāro'nyo guṇībhūtavyaṅgyaḥ kāvyasya dṛśyate| yatra vyaṅgyānvaye vācyacārutvaṃ syātprakarṣavat|| iti| sambhavāpekṣayā cāsya dhvaneḥ svarūpamātrapratipādanārthatvopagame'nyeṣāmapi tadvākyavartināṃ padavarṇasaṃkhyādīnāṃ tadupadarśanaprasaṅgo viśeṣābhāvāditi saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhavyutpattimātrametad paryavasyatīti na kāvyaviśeṣavyutpattiphalam| na cāyaṃ pradhānetarabhāvenopanibaddhasteṣāmanumeyatāṃ pratibadhnāti| tadevaṃ ca nārthaśabdayorupasarjanīkṛtasvārthatvaṃ vyabhicārāsambhavadoṣaduṣṭatvāt| na vācyapratīyamānayorvyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvas tallakṣaṇābhāvāt| na ca kāvyaviśeṣasya lakṣaṇakaraṇaṃ prayojanābhāvāt| nāpi dhvanivyapadeśo vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvābhāvādupapadyate| iti sarvamasamañjasamiva tallakṣaṇamupalakṣyate| yadi kāvye guṇībhūtavyaṅgye'pīṣṭaiva cārutā| prakarṣaśālinī tarhi vyarthamevādaro dhvanau||96|| na hi kāvyātmabhūtasya dhvanestatrāsti sambhavaḥ| tena nirjīvataivāsya syāt prakarṣe kathaiva kā||97|| ato'tadātmabhūtasya ye'bhāvaṃ jagadurdhvaneḥ| te mudhaiva pratikṣiptāḥ svoktibhāvamapaśyatā||98|| atheṣyate sa tatrāpi rasādivyaktyapekṣayā| kāvyamevānyathā na syād rasātmakamidaṃ yataḥ||99|| itthañca gamyamānārthasparśamātramalaṅkṛtiḥ| vācyasyetyetaduktaṃ syānmatā saivānumā tataḥ||100|| iti saṅgrahaślokāḥ| kiṃ ca yadavivakṣitavācyo vivakṣitānyaparavācyaśceti dhvaneḥ prakāradvayamuktaṃ tatra kimidamavivakṣitatvaṃ nāma? iti tātparyato'syārtho vaktavyaḥ| kimavivakṣitatvam? anupādeyatvam utānyaparatvam? anupādeyatvaṃ ca kiṃ sarvātmanāṃśena vā? sarvātmanā'nupādeyatve vyañjakatvamapyasyānupādeyaṃ tasya tadāśritatvāt| tataśca prayoga evāsya duṣṭaḥ syād yathā'nyasya punaruktādeḥ| athāṃśenetyucyate vaktavyastarhyasāvaṃśaḥ| sa ca nirūpyamāṇaḥ svāprādhānya eva paryavasati| tataścāvivakṣitatvamanyaparatvamupasarjanīkṛtātmatvaṃ cetyeka evārtha ityanayā bhaṅgyā svarūpameva dhvaneruktaṃ bhavati na tu tasya prakārabhedaḥ| yasya hi yallakṣaṇānugame satyavāntaraviśeṣasaṃsparśaḥ sa tasya prakāra ityucyate yathā gotvasya śābaleyatvādi na tu tasyaiva sa eva prakāro bhavitumarhati tadanavasthāprasaṅgāt| na cātra viśeṣasaṃsparśaḥ kaścid iti kathamasya dhvaniprakāratvoktiryuktimatī? kiṃ cedaṃ vivakṣitānyaparavācyatvaṃ nāma na buddhyāmahe| yadi vivakṣitatvaṃ nāma pradhānamucyate tat kathaṃ tasyānyaparatvaṃ ghaṭate? anyaparatvaṃ hyanyasyāṅgabhāvo bhaṇyate| yasya cāṅgabhāvaḥ sa kathaṃ tadaiva vivakṣitatvāt prādhānyamanubhavet? iti yad vācyasya vivakṣitatvamanyaparatvaṃ copagataṃ tad vipratiṣiddhaṃ vivakṣitānyaparatvayorvirodhāt| ekāśrayatvena hi prādhānyetarayogitvaṃ viśeṣaṇābhimatārthaviṣayameva saṅgacchate nānyaviṣayam| tadeva hi viśeṣyasyotkarṣādhānanibandhanabhāvena vivakṣitatvāt prādhānyam| upādhibhāvācca vāstavādaprādhānyamanubhavitumalam| yathā he hasta! dakṣiṇa! mṛtasya śiśordvijasya jīvātave visṛja śūdramunau kṛpāṇam| rāmasya pāṇirasi nirbharagarbhakhinnasītāvivāsanapaṭo! karuṇā kutaste|| iti| uttararāmacaritam ityuktam| kiṃ cāsya vivakṣitānyaparavācyasya dhvaniprabhedatve'bhyupagamyamāne vācyasyānyaparatvamanupādeyameva tasya tatprabhedatvādeva siddheḥ| anyaparatvaṃ hyupasarjanīkṛtārthatvam| tacca dhvaneḥ sāmānyaṃ rūpamuktameva| yathā'tra tadupādīyate pūrvatrāpi tadupādīyatām ubhayatrāpi vā mopādāyy ubhayorapi tatprakāratvāviśeṣāt| kiṃ
